messages.subject: Time recording - September month-end reminder
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

Friendly reminder that all September time must be recorded and released by 5pm on Wednesday 2 October for month-end billing. Several matters currently show unposted time. Please also ensure narratives are client-ready.

Thanks
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
